HoldConfirmed.description: Check accepted hold, completed motion cancellation and low speed.

HumanDetected.description: A new person is locked: not handled before and not next to an earlier geotag.

IfThenElse.description: Select a then/else branch from a condition result.

Inverter.description: Swap success and failure of a child.
Inverter.safety: Do not invert a safety gate to authorize unsafe operation.

IsFlying.safety: Do not treat as complete position or battery readiness.

IsPersonDetected.description: Check a fresh person detection above confidence threshold.
IsPersonDetected.safety: Detection does not establish stable identity, location or delivery permission.

KeepRunningUntilFailure.description: Keep a child active until it fails.
KeepRunningUntilFailure.safety: Pair with a mission timeout or explicit exit condition.

Land.description: Run the standard AS2 landing action.
Land.safety: Use ManagedLand for monitored rescue lifecycle completion.

PayloadLoaded.description: Check fresh physical presence and latch sensors.

PayloadOperatorConfirmed.description: Check a mission-bound preflight operator load assertion.

PeersFresh.description: Check all configured peers have fresh common-frame reports.

ReactiveSequence.description: Recheck earlier conditions while a later child runs.
ReactiveSequence.safety: A lost guard can halt an action; cancellation still needs confirmation.

RecoverThenFail.description: Run recovery after task failure, then preserve FAILURE.
RecoverThenFail.safety: A successful recovery must not label the failed mission successful.
